question_text: A glass of fresh orange solution of volume 500 $cm^3$ contains a few orange seeds at bottom. It was observed that the addition of sugar does not alter the volume of the solution. If the density of the orange solution before adding sugar was 1000 $kg/m^3$ and the density of orange seeds is 10 times the density of the solution. Assume that the seeds are insoluble in the solution. What is the percentage increase in density of the solution after adding sugar on a smooth bend with a weight in the angular velocity becomes equal to an angular velocity when he bends his hands towards his body, the each extended hand is rotating with an angular velocity $\omega_0$
